title: ReFRAG OperatorCandidate
description: A candidate operator used as a 'query' against the spectral index. In text-mode refrag the query is a text string; in OD mode it is a candidate operator whose spectral signature is matched against data regions to find where it is most testable/falsifiable. Mirrors the OperatorCandidate dataclass at adapters/od_refrag_adapter.py:75.

operator_id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for the candidate operator.

spectral_signature.description: Dense vector projected into the same space as chunk embeddings (length must equal d_enc of the encoder in use).

coefficients.description: Named scalar coefficients describing the candidate operator (e.g. 'lambda': 500.0). Empty by default.

source_domain.description: Domain tag for cross-domain transfer detection (e.g. 'quantum', 'markets', 'turbulence'). Empty string if not tagged.
